open.text: {you}. You left our banner in the mud. There will be no ransom today—only iron!

interject.text: His front rank is steady, captain, but his levies look cold and hungry.

choices.label: Settle it steel to steel—you and me, before both lines.
Your men are spent. Yield the field and spare them.
Your dead fought well. Let old blood rest and grant us the road.
Take 150 crowns for your trouble and march back home.

duel_accept.text: Ha! At least you have a spine. Step forward, {you}. Let both hosts watch!

interject.text: Watch his high guard, captain—he'll bait your swing.

choices.label: Draw steel and meet him in single combat.
No—back to the lines. Our companies settle this.

yield_reply.text: You think a handful of mail coats scares {realm}? Sound the horns—we fight!

choices.label: Then let iron decide it.

honour_reply.text: ...They did die with their boots planted. Take the road, {you}. Next time we owe each other nothing.

choices.label: Fair road to you, {name}. (End encounter peacefully)

bribe_reply.text: Hmph. Silver spends cleaner than blood. Take your banners and be gone before I change my mind.

choices.label: Pleasure doing business. (Pay 150g, leave peacefully)

open.text: Well met on hard ground, {you}. Will you bend the knee to {realm}, or feed the crows?

interject.text: Hold your nerve, captain. His horse is restless on the flank.

choices.label: Save the men—meet me in single combat right here.
Neither of us needs a butcher's bill today. Let us pass.
150 crowns to look the other way while we march past.
Enough talk. Let's get to the steel.

duel_open.text: Bold words, {you}! Step into the mud, then—we settle this blade to blade!

choices.label: Enter single combat.
Return to battle lines.

pass_reply.text: My orders are clear, {you}. No free passage through {realm} lands.

choices.label: Then we take the road by force.

coin_reply.text: A practical captain. Keep your men in column and out of sight—we saw nothing.

choices.label: Pay 150 crowns and march past.

open.text: Speak freely, {you}. What brings a captain of your name before {house}?

choices.label: I came to pay respect to {house} and hear news of the war.
Tell me straight—where is the real fighting in {realm}?
Every lord needs a quiet blade. Remember my name when coin moves.

warm_end.text: Well spoken, {you}. Courtesy is rare when iron is cheap. Sit—let us talk business.

choices.label: Continue to council topics.

blunt_end.text: Direct as a pike. I like that. The marches bleed, and we need companies that don't break.

choices.label: Continue to council topics.

sly_end.text: Careful how loudly you offer that in court, {you}... though I will remember it.

choices.label: Continue to council topics.
